method: Actual browser module; fixed preset; strict date-before-fixture cutoff; shared aliases; administrative scores excluded
limitations: Retrospective diagnostic only; no prospective validation, bookmaker prices or yield/ROI evidence

policy.cutoff: strictly before fixture date; all same-day scores excluded
policy.comparison: Positive Brier improvement means lower error than the named baseline; approximate 95% intervals cluster paired errors by calendar week
policy.exploratory_groups: League, season and market comparisons are exploratory; intervals are not adjusted for multiple comparisons
policy.small_samples: No directional evidence label below 500 games or 12 calendar weeks; calibration bins below 100 are labelled small
policy.interpretation: All periods are retrospective with the currently corrected archive and code. Later periods were separated before this replay but are not genuinely unseen prospective data. Do not select a live window from these tests alone.
